_comment: v1 SKILL family manifest. Each entry declares (a) the per-run workspace overlay that installs one or more `.opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` files, (b) the user prompt (deliberately distinct from the SKILL body so we measure SKILL-mediated procedure-loading vs prompt-based prescription), (c) classified pass criteria, and (d) the structural_signature triple (template, scope_kind, answer_shape) used by the authoring gate to enforce diversity across the family. Skill fixtures live under `projects/v1/skills/<sid>/.opencode/skills/<name>/...`. Family invariant: all `skill name=X` invocations are expected at the parent agent layer; the explore subagent (and any agent with skill in disabled-permissions) does NOT see the skills catalog and cannot load skills. Source confirmed against opencode session/system.ts:65-77 and skill/index.ts:262-278.

samples._authoring_notes: Hello-world for the SKILL family. Workflow-style skill (procedural prose) on requests. Prompt mentions 'a procedural skill' to nudge discovery; passing requires the model to actually invoke the `skill` tool with name=review-flow. Tier-A baseline; no structural-triple collisions yet.
